text: {"lessons":["My account has moved both up and down over short periods, so I should not treat a few months of performance as proof that a strategy is working or failing.","I added to all five stocks in Period 6 without selling any; before adding again, I should check my cash, position sizes, and whether the added risk still fits my apartment goal.","Trades at the prices available then do not guarantee good results; I should base future buys or sells on a considered plan rather than simply repeating equal purchases."]}
